title: Dungeon game
statement: A knight starts at the top-left and moves only right or down to the princess at the bottom-right. Each cell adds its value to his health (negative is damage). His health must stay ≥ 1 at every moment. Return the minimum starting health.
hints: Going forwards you'd need to track two things: current health and the minimum so far. Go backwards instead.
need[i][j] = the minimum health on entering (i, j) to survive to the end = max(1, min(need below, need right) − d[i][j]).

solution.explanation: A forward DP on "maximum health remaining" is wrong: a path can arrive with more health but have needed a larger start. The fix is reversing the direction so the state is a single number with optimal substructure: the health needed when entering a cell depends only on the cells after it. When a forward state needs two numbers that trade off, try solving backwards.
